estimand: Area fraction of mapped baseline mangrove pixels within the global GUB2018 large-city interface represented by the actual fixed research reference population.
numerator: Actual 934814 fixed reference centres, checked by intersection with the recomputed global interface.
denominator: Union of GMW v4.1.12 annual presence in 2000-2004, intersected with the union of GUB2018 urbanArea >100 km2 polygon buffers.
tile_catalog_name_rule: Use the unique tilename property, checked against geometry/native bounds; the gmw_tilename property is a repeated value in the official GeoJSON and is not used.
coverage_comparison: The represented area fraction is compared with 0.75.
